title: Layout
description:
A record layout as its file states it: the fields of a record, their byte order, and for a
serial console's capture, the block the records are in.

block.description:
For a serial console's capture of the records as base64, the name of the block they are
in, as the capture's start marker names it ([`capture`]); `None` for a file of the
records' bytes.

byte_order.description: The order of each field's bytes: little-endian unless the layout says otherwise.

fields.description:
Each field of a record, in the record's order. A field's name states its unit as a
table's header does, such as `Time (ms)` or `pressure__pa`: the records are written out
as a table under those names and read by what they state ([`records::read`]), so one
field must be a clock in a unit of time.

ByteOrder.description: The order of a field's bytes.

oneOf.description: The least significant byte first, as ARM and x86 processors store a number.

Field.description: One field of a record: its name, as a table's header would write it, and its type.

name.description:
The field's name, its unit in it where it has one, such as `pressure__kpa` or `Time (ms)`
([`generic`]'s *Units in a name*).

FieldKind.description: The type of one field of a record.
